sources.note: MEXT's own recruitment page for the 2027 embassy-recommended Research Students scholarship (Japanese); live and unchanged, and it links the 2027 English application guidelines PDF.
Study in Japan Official Website (JASSO, government-approved, MEXT-linked) English page for the MEXT Scholarship for 2027 Embassy Recommendation; read in full.

The 2027 English 'APPLICATION GUIDELINES JAPANESE GOVERNMENT (MEXT) SCHOLARSHIP FOR 2027 (RESEARCH STUDENTS)' PDF linked from the MEXT page. Its text could not be rendered in my toolchain (PDF fetch returns raw bytes); the quoted wording is the search-engine index text of this exact official URL, corroborated verbatim by the official embassy pages below.
Consulate-General of Japan in Hong Kong research-students page: shows the 2027 window as closed ('Currently Open for Application NO'; application period 05 May 2026 to 10 June 2026).
Embassy of Japan in Pakistan: 'Last date to apply for the scholarship was 26th May 2026.'

awarding_body.detail: The record is on MEXT's own domain and the English Study in Japan page confirms administration through Japanese embassies/consulates, exactly as the record describes. This is the awarding organisation's own page, not an aggregator.
awarding_body.quote: DO NOT send any application documents directly to MEXT (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology) in Japan.

deadline.detail: The record's claim that no central deadline is published and that applicants must contact their own Japanese embassy is confirmed word-for-word by the official Study in Japan page. However, the official page also states recruitment runs April-May of the previous year with first screening May-July, and the embassy pages checked show the 2027 window closed in May-June 2026, so the cycle is not currently open on 12 October 2026. The record's deadline claim is accurate but the cycle has passed its window.
deadline.quote: Recruitment for those arriving in Japan in April 2027 or September/October 2027 is made between April and May of the previous year. First screening is conducted between May and July by the Japanese Embassies or Consulates General. As the application process and specific schedule differ according to the country of your nationality, please inquire the Japanese Embassy or Consulate General in your country for details.

eligibility.detail: The record's 'under 35 years of age' and master's/doctoral admission claims match the 2027 guidelines and the official embassy summaries. Age limit for the 2027 cycle is birth on or after April 2, 1992; level is graduate school (Master's Course/Ph.D. Course).
eligibility.quote: (2) Age: Applicants, in principle, must have been born on or after April 2, 1992.

funding.detail: The record's funding description matches the 2027 guidelines exactly: 143,000 yen/month for preparatory education and non-regular students, 144,000 for master's/professional degree students, 145,000 for doctoral students, plus a 2,000 or 3,000 yen monthly regional allowance. Official embassy pages add that MEXT also covers tuition and flights (e.g., Embassy of Japan in Ireland: 'MEXT will cover entrance examination, matriculation and university tuition fees, and flights to and from Japan, and provide a monthly allowance of between JPY143,000 and JPY145,000 (subject to change).'), so it is a full-award package, not tuition-only.
funding.quote: ① Students receiving the preparatory education and non-regular students: 143,000 yen per month ② Regular students enrolled in master's or professional degree courses: 144,000 yen per month ③ Regular students enrolled in doctoral courses: 145,000 yen per month.

degree_levels.detail: The programme is for graduate-level study: research students are defined as those enrolled in a master's course, a doctoral course, or a professional graduate course, consistent with the record's 'Master's, PhD'.
degree_levels.quote: DEFINITION OF “RESEARCH STUDENTS” Those who are enrolled in a master’s course, a doctoral course, or a professional graduate course at a graduate school, or who are conducting research in a specialized field at an undergraduate department, graduate school, institute attached to a university, etc.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: No central deadline is published. The official Study in Japan page states: "Recruitment for those arriving in Japan in April 2027 or September/October 2027 is made between April and May of the previous year. First screening is conducted between May and July by the Japanese Embassies or Consulates General. As the application process and specific schedule differ according to the country of your nationality, please inquire the Japanese Embassy or Consulate General in your country for details." For the 2027 cycle the embassy windows ran roughly May-June 2026 (e.g., Hong Kong: 05 May 2026 to 10 June 2026, now closed; Pakistan: last date 26 May 2026) and are now closed.
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Re-check when the next cycle's guidelines publish (MEXT/Study in Japan typically post the following year's Research Students guidelines in spring; English entry point: https://www.studyinjapan.go.jp/en/smap-stopj-applications-research.html). 2027-cycle facts confirmed on 2026-10-12: age limit born on or after 1992-04-02; stipend 143,000/144,000/145,000 yen per month by enrolment status plus 2,000/3,000 yen regional allowance; embassy recommendation only (no direct applications to MEXT). The 2027 embassy-recommendation window has closed at the embassy stage, so the record should not be flipped to active until the next cycle opens.

notes_for_reviewer: All five claims in the record check out against official MEXT/JASSO pages, so nothing is contradicted. The reason this is needs_review rather than active is cycle currency: the official Study in Japan page states recruitment happens April-May of the previous year, and every embassy checked (Hong Kong, Pakistan, Ireland, Israel, India) shows the 2027 Research Students window closed in May-June 2026, with MEXT results due January-March 2027. The record as written cannot certify a currently-open cycle, and it does not tell a reader that the 2027 window has passed. A human may decide either to keep needs_review until the 2028 call opens, or to mark active-with-past-deadline if the catalogue tracks completed cycles separately. One transparency note: my toolchain cannot render PDFs (fetches return raw bytes), so the guidelines quotations are the search-index text of the exact official PDF URL, corroborated verbatim by multiple official Japanese embassy pages; the two pages I read in full are the MEXT page and the Study in Japan page.
